description: Tools the harness may need that are not in the Python standard library. python.install_command: the command your company approves for installing a Python package, with {package} where the name goes (for example `python -m pip install --index-url https://pypi.example.com/simple --trusted-host pypi.example.com {package}`). It is empty by default: the harness never guesses an install command and never runs one; an agent cannot (the gate refuses package installs). It prints the command for you to run. python.interpreter: the one Python the `harness` command runs on (a full path). Empty, it runs on the first python3 of the PATH of the terminal that starts it, which can differ from terminal to terminal, so a package installed into one is not found by another. When it is set and the command finds itself on another Python, it starts again on this one. The install command must install into this Python. Put your own in tools.override.json (the skill harness-rookie-get-me-ready asks for both). optional_packages: what `task intake convert` can read when the package is there; without it that kind of file is kept as it is and not converted. Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx) need nothing installed.

optional_packages.used_for: the text of PDF files (not scanned pages)
